demo.title: check-before-buy.txt
demo.code:
You:   buy $20 of NVIDIA on Base
Bankr: Proof of Stock: Coinbase's own NVDAc is 0x… (issuer-listed).
       Buy $20 of NVDAc at that address? (yes/no)

(later)
You:   is 0x02ec…b384 the real SanDisk token?
Bankr: Proof of Stock: LOOK-ALIKE. Not on Coinbase's list; it imitates SNDKc.
       Coinbase's own SNDKc is 0xb200…10c5.

setup: Install the skill with the button below
Say: "is 0x… the real NVIDIA token?" to check a contract
Say: "which contract is Coinbase's TSLA?" to get the issuer's own address before you buy
No key, no wallet: the check is read-only
